Thus, six Season 1 episodes were not directed solely by Brändström. 3. In Season 2, citation [4] identifies three episodes directed by Brändström solo; the two she co-directed are not directed solely by her, and the remaining episodes are not identified as solo-directed by her. Therefore five Season 2 episodes were not directed solely by Brändström. 4. Adding the seasons gives 6 + 5 = 11. The citations contain the information needed to derive the gold target.
